# openai_webhook_endpoint (Data Source)

Retrieve a project webhook endpoint by ID using a project API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_webhook_endpoint" "example" {
  id = "whe_0000000000000000000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Webhook endpoint identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) created at
- `event_types` (Set of String) event types
- `name` (String) name
- `object` (String) object
- `response_json` (String) Raw JSON response returned by the OpenAI API.
- `signing_secret_hint` (String) signing secret hint
- `updated_at` (Number) updated at
- `url` (String) url
